properties.name: The confusability replica ranks what find_tools ranks, and CI checks it against the live ranker
properties.rationale: fact:the-confusability-replica-ranks-a-bulk-door-sentence-find-tools-never-sees-2026-10-03, confirmed on main at 293f957: the new validator over the old scoring reported 186/193 top-1 and 115/193 exact top-5, as the finding measured. THE CLASS: a replica scored the published surface while the live ranker scores the router's, and its agreement was checked once by hand against a saved file (the --validate path read a scratchpad file from another session). The echo parameter was the same class and is stripped too. Not established: the four remaining exact-top-5 differences.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: tools/tool_confusability.py strips what tools/list adds at list time (the draw_edges sentence on 32 edge helpers, the echo parameter, a lessons block) before scoring, agreeing with the live find_tools on 193 of 193 corpus queries at top 1 (189 at an exact top 5). --validate asks the real binary and exits 1 on any top-1 disagreement, and runs in ci.yml; --baseline validates first and refuses to rewrite the ratchet otherwise.
